entries.subject: Dinner? Just the two of us.
entries.body:
[i]“No lawyers, no trades on the table. I want to talk about where this is going — you, me, the next few years. You pick the restaurant, I'll pick the subject.”[/i]

{client} is asking for the conversation that contracts only pretend to be.

choices.label: Postpone — the season is brutal

effects.text: You postpone the dinner with {client}. Postponed conversations grow teeth.

choices.outcome: “Of course. When things calm down.” Things never calm down, and you both know it.

expire_effects.text: The dinner invitation from {client} went unanswered. That silence has a price.
